subject: business_studies
question_text: What is meant by internal trade?
answer_text: Buying and selling of goods and services within the boundaries of a nation are referred to as internal trade. Purchases of goods from a local shop, a mall or an exhibition are all examples of internal trade. No custom duty or import duty is levied on these goods and services. It can be classified into two broad categories: wholesale trade and retailing trade.
final_answer: Internal trade includes all transactions within a nation's borders without customs duties.
difficulty_reasoning: Direct recall of the definition of internal trade.

subject: business_studies
question_text: Specify the characteristics of fixed shop retailers.
answer_text: The characteristics of fixed shop retailers are: They have greater resources and operate at a relatively large scale as compared with the itinerant traders. These retailers deal in different products, including consumer durables as well as non-durables. They have greater credibility in the minds of customers. They are in a position to provide greater services to the customers such as home delivery, repairs, credit facilities etc.
final_answer: Fixed shop retailers are larger, more credible, and offer better services than itinerant traders.
difficulty_reasoning: Requires understanding of the characteristics of fixed shop retailers.

subject: business_studies
question_text: What purpose is served by wholesalers providing warehousing facilities?
answer_text: Two purposes are served by wholesalers providing warehousing facilities: Wholesalers reduce the burden of manufacturers of providing for storage facilities for the finished products. Warehousing by wholesalers also relieves the retailers of the work of collecting goods from several producers and keeping a big inventory of the same for maintaining adequate stock of varied commodities for the customers.
final_answer: Wholesalers help manufacturers with storage and assist retailers in inventory management.
difficulty_reasoning: Requires understanding of the role of wholesalers in warehousing.

subject: business_studies
question_text: How does the wholesaler help the manufacturer in availing the economies of scale?
answer_text: Wholesalers collect small orders from a number of retailers and pass on the pool of such orders to the manufacturers and make purchases in bulk quantities. This enables the producers to undertake production on a large scale and take advantage of the economies of scale.
final_answer: Thus, wholesalers facilitate large-scale production for manufacturers.
difficulty_reasoning: Requires understanding of the role of wholesalers in the supply chain.

subject: business_studies
question_text: Distinguish between single line stores and speciality stores. Can you identify such stores in your locality?
answer_text: Single-line stores deal only in a particular type of product from a selected product line, while speciality stores are small shops that deal in only one product, offering a wide variety of that product.
final_answer: Therefore, single-line stores focus on a product category, whereas speciality stores focus on a specific product.
difficulty_reasoning: Involves understanding and comparing different types of retail stores.

subject: business_studies
question_text: How would you differentiate between street traders and street shops?
answer_text: Street traders are small retailers who generally sell low-priced consumer items on streets, while street shops are situated on street sides or main roads and do not have permanent shops.
final_answer: Thus, street traders operate without a fixed location, whereas street shops have a designated place.
difficulty_reasoning: Requires understanding of different retail formats in street commerce.

subject: business_studies
question_text: Explain the services offered by wholesalers to manufacturers.
answer_text: The services offered by wholesalers to manufacturers include facilitating large scale production and bearing risk.
final_answer: Therefore, wholesalers play a crucial role in supporting manufacturers by managing production and risk.
difficulty_reasoning: Involves understanding multiple roles of wholesalers in the supply chain.

subject: business_studies
question_text: Imagine life without your local market. What difficulties would a consumer face if there is no retail shop?
answer_text: There are a lot of difficulties people would face if there is no retail shop as these act as a link between manufacturers/wholesalers and consumers. If there is no retail shop in our neighbourhood, life becomes very hard. For buying any simple or daily use product, we have to travel a lot of distance. We can buy certain items as and when required if some retail stores are within walking distance from our house. In case of emergency, we can easily get medicine and other necessary items if some shops are nearby. Otherwise, life can be very difficult. They play an essential role due to the following things: Regular availability of products, New products information, Convenience in buying, Wide selection, After-sales services, and Provide credit facilities.
final_answer: Therefore, without retail shops, consumers would face significant challenges in accessing products and services conveniently.
difficulty_reasoning: Requires understanding the role of retail shops and their impact on consumer convenience.

subject: business_studies
question_text: What are the usefulness of mail order houses?
answer_text: The usefulness of mail order houses includes limited capital requirement, elimination of middlemen, absence of bad debt, wide reach, and convenience.
final_answer: Thus, mail order houses provide significant advantages in terms of cost and convenience for consumers.
difficulty_reasoning: Requires understanding of the concept and listing of benefits.

subject: business_studies
question_text: What types of products are usually handled by mail order houses?
answer_text: Types of products usually handled by mail order houses include graded and standardized goods, goods that can be easily transported at low cost, goods with ready demand in the market, and goods that can be easily described through pictures.
final_answer: Therefore, mail order houses typically deal with products that are easy to transport and have a clear market demand.
difficulty_reasoning: Involves recalling specific types of products and their characteristics.
